# Calling a partner, as in FBB's documentation: this side's SID and first
# proposal straight away; the partner wants the first and third messages and
# sends its own proposal, which says it had them; this side, with nothing
# more, says FF, and the partner, with nothing either, FQ.
@queued P Q9TEST Q2BBS.#12.GBR.EURO Q1TEST 5_Q1BBS
@queued P Q8TEST Q2BBS Q7TEST 6_Q1BBS
@queued B Q9TEST GBR ALL 7_Q1BBS
@calling
< [SAMBBS-0.0-FH$]
< FB P Q9TEST Q2BBS.#12.GBR.EURO Q1TEST 5_Q1BBS 44
< FB P Q8TEST Q2BBS Q7TEST 6_Q1BBS 44
< FB B Q9TEST GBR ALL 7_Q1BBS 44
< F> A8
> FS +-+
< Title 1
< R:261031/1200Z @:Q1BBS.#77.GBR.EURO
< Body 1.
< ^Z
< Title 3
< R:261031/1200Z @:Q1BBS.#77.GBR.EURO
< Body 3.
< ^Z
@check accepted=0 forwarded=0 refused=1 pending=2
> FB P Q2TEST Q1BBS Q1TEST 40_Q2BBS 7
> F> 29
< FS +
@check accepted=0 forwarded=2 refused=1 pending=0
> Back to you
> Hi.^Z
< FF
> FQ
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=1 forwarded=2 refused=1 pending=0
